svg.title: Tab bar (MU-01): track 28 pt, active pill 24 pt inset 2, new-tab circle 30 pt
svg.text: track: 28 tall, radius 14, 1 pt border, from x +8 of the content to 3 pt before the button
active pill: 24 tall, inset 2 · separators 1 × 16 between inactive tabs · button: circle 30, 7 pt from the right edge
close × on hover: 18 × 18 target at x +4 of the tab (left side)
